episodes.focal_question: 监管机构如何因TD银行BSA/AML合规缺陷而采取执法行动及施加整改要求？
episodes.title: 监管机构就TD银行BSA/AML缺陷采取的执法行动与整改要求

elements.label: TD Bank's BSA/AML compliance deficiencies (insufficient risk assessment and CDD, inadequate transaction monitoring, deficient SAR processes, underfunded AML program, failure to detect suspicious transactions and employee misconduct)
FinCEN assessed a US$1.3 billion penalty against TD Bank's US subsidiaries
FinCEN-mandated four-year independent monitorship to oversee remediation efforts
OCC and Federal Reserve reached parallel settlements with TD Bank
Comprehensive improvements mandated: risk management program improvements, enhanced board oversight, independent testing and validation, regular progress reporting to regulators
Accountability Review as part of remediation
Potential disciplinary actions: dismissal for current employees found responsible, or recoupment of prior compensation for former employees

relations.source_quote: In 2024, FinCEN assessed a US$1.3 billion penalty against the US subsidiaries of Toronto Dominion (TD) Bank for violations of the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA).
In addition to the financial penalty, TD Bank faced a FinCEN-mandated fouryear independent monitorship to oversee its remediation efforts.
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) and the Federal Reserve reached parallel settlements with the bank.

The enforcement actions mandated comprehensive improvements to its risk management program, enhanced board oversight requirements, independent testing and validation, and regular progress reporting to regulators.
